messages.content: Who are in the cricket matches scheduled for today?

function.name: sports_analyzer_get_schedule
function.description: Retrieve the schedule of cricket matches for a specific date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

date.description: The date for which to get the schedule of matches.

sport.description: The type of sport. Default is cricket.

country.description: The country for which to get the schedule. If not provided, all countries will be included. Default: 'USA'

So we need to retrieve schedule for today's date. The function expects date string. We can use today's date: 2026-06-17. Sport default cricket. Country optional; default USA. The default is USA. But we might want all. The function says default: 'USA', but we can provide country param. If we want all countries, we can set country=""? Not sure. The function doc says "If not provided, all countries will be included. Default: 'USA'". That seems contradictory: default is USA but if not provided, all countries will be included. Maybe default is USA but if omitted, all countries. Let's just omit country to get all. So call function with date and sport.
